string.text: Spectrum Laboratory is checking its protective and biological circuits against natural artefacts. A specific sample has been selected for the current measurement series.
Spectrum needs one natural sample to calibrate protective and biological circuits. The required artefact is listed in the offer.
Thermosphere Institute is preparing another cycle of thermal and electrical tests. The test bench requires one natural artefact of the specified type.
Thermosphere requests one sample for a thermal or electrical test bench. Its type is fixed when the offer is published.
The Three Candles group is comparing the gravitational and portable fields of natural artefacts. Their next experiment requires one sample of the specified type.
Three Candles needs one natural sample for a field experiment. The requested artefact is listed among the required items.
